title: Choice sets, group splits and fair baselines
citation: Greene and Hensher, 1987 intercity mode-choice sample documented in Greene (1997/2011); statsmodels distribution.
observation_unit: One alternative offered to one traveler. Four rows form one choice set.
scope_limitations: 840 alternatives, 210 travelers. Choice-based sampling oversamples some modes; not population market shares.
acquisition: offline export from installed package distribution; no invented records
transforms: Preserved loaded values and row order; added zero-based row_id.
Calendar fields cast to integers; CO2 datetime index exported as ISO date.
Missing CO2 observations remain blank, never zero.

schema.name: row_id
schema.units: source scale; see data card (not guessed)

schema.name: choice
schema.description: One selected alternative per choice set.

schema.name: ttme
schema.description: Terminal waiting time, zero for car.

schema.name: invc
schema.description: In-vehicle monetary cost; not inflation-adjusted here.

schema.name: gc
schema.description: Generalized cost combining cost and time; excluded to avoid double-counting.

schema.name: psize
schema.description: Group size in the chosen mode; excluded because availability for prospective choice is uncertain.
